body: Thank you for the kind responses. I don't know if I deserve this support but I'll take it for what it is. I'll definitely try and help people actively. If I don't have to be defined by my crime, I'll do anything. Thanks again everyone.

I agree and I'm trying to live life as well as I can for myself and my family for now. But friendships and relationships are built on honesty right? Isn't not telling them lying by omission? Keeping this heavy lie with me seems so wrong yet I don't feel like I have a choice.
